description: Data for Artificial Intelligence: Data-Centric AI for Transportation: Work Zone Use Case Raw Maryland Incidents is a dataset listed in data.transportation.gov (U.S. DOT open data portal), an open data portal of the U.S. Department of Transportation under the section "Roadways and Bridges", published or maintained by U.S. Department of Transportation Intelligent Transportation Systems Joint Program Office (JPO) -- Recommended citation: "U.S. Department of Transportation Federal Highway Administration. (2024). Data for Artificial Intelligence: Data-Centric AI for Transportation: Work Zone Use Case Raw Maryland Incidents. [Dataset]. Provided by ITS DataHub through Data.transportation.gov. Accessed YYYY-MM-DD from https://doi.org/10.21949/1404195". Data for Artificial Intelligence: Data-Centric AI for Transportation: Work Zone Use Case proposes a data integration pipeline that enhances the utilization of work zone and traffic data from diversified platforms and introduces a novel deep learning model to predict the traffic speed and traffic collision likelihood during planned work zone events. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Roadways and Bridges". It has 17 columns, among them direction, creation_date, road_name_2, end_cross_street, start_latitude, start_date. The portal shows 2024-09-16 as the last data update. Attribution given: U.S. Department of Transportation Intelligent Transportation Systems Joint Program Office (JPO) -- Recommended citation:. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-usdot-data-transportation-gov-portal.
